statement.essentials: An artery and a vein also run through the gland, and in most people the nerve lies on their outer side.
statement.anatomy: The retromandibular vein and the external carotid artery run through the gland. In dissections of 30 adult cadavers the facial nerve lay lateral (outside) to the retromandibular vein in 86.7% and lateral to the external carotid artery in 80%.

limitations: One small cadaveric series from one country, differing between the two sides of the body; the relation is not constant, and in some specimens the upper division loops around the vein. The model draws the usual relation.
